title: Cornucopias - COPI Cafe Episode 16
description:
In this latest episode of COPICafe, Cornucopias CEOs Rob Greig and Josh Jones discuss the latest events from within the Cornucopias metaverse game. Rob and Josh answer community questions. Later in this episode they are joined by Army of Spies to discuss NFTs and all things Cornucopias. Listen to the corn-brains behind it all as they discuss Cornucopias' latest developments. 

Crack open your favorite beverage, enjoy this information-packed chat in the casual, comfy, corntastic episode of COPICafe!

0:00 - Intro
0:57 - Beverage Choices
2:25 - Josh's New Hat
4:42 - Happy Birthday Rob!
6:30 - Questions from Discord
6:56 - Wen NFT Staking?
8:25 - Wen Tokenomics Document?
10:53 - Wen Custom Dome Sales?
12:10 - NFT Marketplace Upgrades
13:20 - Wen Chainport Bridge?
13:50 - Mobile Testing Update
16:29 - Special Guest - Army of Spies
20:35 - Army of Spies' Introduction to Crypto + Cardano
22:40 - Army of Spies' YouTube Channel
26:51 - Market Trends
28:26 - NFTs
33:12 - Music + Real Estate NFTs
34:40 - Tokenization of Everything and Intellectual Property
38:18 - Last Weeks Leak Recap
39:23 - VIDEO LEAK
39:41 - FINAL LEAK

Army of Spies Links:
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/c/ArmyofSpies
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ArmySpies

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
